Interactive Canvas Editor
|-- Workspace assembly: MappingPage.tsx
|   |-- MappingServices -> CanvasWorkspace + storage + source view state
|   |-- Agent bridge -> handleAgentCommand
|   |   |-- reads -> controller snapshot, identity, nodes, edges and revisions
|   |   `-- edits -> controller commands / DiagramRevisionReceiver / CanvasViewReceiver
|   |-- Each opened draft mounts MappingEditorCanvas(session)
|   |   |-- tldraw Editor + CanvasRuntimeContext
|   |   `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas -> application actions and overlays
|   `-- CanvasWorkspace owns session lifetimes
|       |-- draft metadata + stable CanvasSession + controller registry
|       |-- document changes -> refresh draft entry for search/explorer
|       |-- checkpoint commits -> workspace change notification + persistence request
|       `-- replaced/removed draft -> unsubscribe and dispose its session
|-- [S] Semantic state: CanvasSession + MappingDocumentController
|   |-- Controller supplies commands, snapshots and checkpoint history
|   |   `-- Mounted editor and headless callers use the same domain commands
|   |-- Synchronous publication through focused, read-only stores
|   |   |-- document     -> semantic scene, edges and document data
|   |   |-- presentation -> display panes + diagram views
|   |   |-- selection    -> ordered selection membership
|   |   |-- controls     -> focus and action surface state
|   |   |-- geometry     -> endpoint bounds, cell metrics and version
|   |   `-- status       -> dirty state + undo/redo availability
|   |-- canvasRevisionId changes -> onCommit listeners
|   `-- Dirty baseline compares saved scene, edges and name
|       `-- Save acknowledgement names the captured baseline;
|           newer edits remain dirty
|-- Live interaction: MappingEditorCanvas + MappingEditorRuntime
|   |-- tldraw owns live shape geometry, camera and native undo navigation
|   |   |-- pointer movement -> editor records; no semantic commit per frame
|   |   `-- camera -> overlay transform + separately captured view state
|   |-- Idle tick after pointing/dragging/pinching ends -> settle()
|   |   |-- diagram movement -> grid coordinates -> move operation
|   |   |-- supported diagram clone -> duplicate-instance operation
|   |   |-- unsupported pane/group clone -> remove temporary native clone
|   |   |-- pane movement/resize -> display geometry + manual/fixed policy
|   |   `-- changed geometry -> commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas) -> [S]
|   |-- Controller changes -> project shapes and checkpoint into editor
|   |   |-- unchanged checkpoint while pointing -> defer projection
|   |   `-- new command checkpoint -> native history stopping point
|   |-- Undo/redo
|   |   |-- startup -> replay checkpoint references; materialize current shapes
|   |   |-- native history changes mappingCheckpoint
|   |   |   `-- restoreEditorCheckpoint -> [S] -> reproject shapes
|   |   `-- cross-canvas transfer boundary -> MappingPage workspace undo/redo
|   |       `-- coordinate participating canvases and persist transfer state
|   `-- Unmount -> complete and settle gesture, detach listeners, release runtime
|-- Selection and attached UI: MappingCanvas.tsx
|   |-- Node click / marquee / whole-diagram gesture -> controller.updateCanvas
|   |   `-- selectionState.ts owns identity, deduplication and insertion order
|   |       |-- whole diagram -> displayNodeId without a region
|   |       `-- region -> source identity + ASCII + captured canonical node IDs
|   |           |-- rectangle is a presentation envelope
|   |           |-- current membership resolves from explicit IDs
|   |           `-- mismatched source content -> no selected content nodes
|   |-- Native shape selection enables dragging
|   |   `-- Explicit application gestures own semantic content membership
|   |-- Retain selection -> displayModel.ts SelectionRegion
|   |   |-- selection/projection/conversation/detail panes form an ownership tree
|   |   |-- membership stays in SelectionState; focus and panels have separate lives
|   |   |-- stacked projections show active child; chained mode traverses children
|   |   `-- remove pane -> remove descendants and repair parent references
|   |-- Selected canonical nodes -> handleNodeSelect -> mapped code panel
|   |   `-- source pane integration opens mapped source through repository services
|   `-- CanvasActions bridge -> collapse, group, move, remove, jump, chat and undo
|       `-- application commands return through [S]
|-- Rendering derives from [S]
|   |-- shapeProjection.ts: projectMappingShapes(snapshot)
|   |   |-- presentation scene + diagram views -> grid boxes in pixel coordinates
|   |   |-- nested boxes -> native parent/child shapes with stable mapping IDs
|   |   |-- visible floating panes -> native shapes
|   |   `-- document edges + side panels -> locked shapes
|   |-- CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx: CanvasRuntime.sync()
|   |   |-- per-ID grid, panel, float and edge models
|   |   |-- shareEqual preserves unchanged branches across document clones
|   |   |-- selected content resolves through the same selection membership
|   |   `-- endpoint identities + layout keys -> local anchors and edge models
|   `-- Native mode leaves shape rendering to tldraw
|       `-- MappingCanvas keeps selection/actions/overlays;
|           legacy composed text and connection rendering are bypassed
|-- Connection routing: NativeRoutingStore
|   |-- document.edges are authoritative; display panes do not persist arrow copies
|   |-- semantic obstacles or matching measurements + live shape transforms
|   |   `-- world-space obstacles; camera changes are not dependencies
|   |-- dragging -> preview edges using last settled routes
|   `-- settled geometry
|       |-- worker available -> one in-flight job + newest pending job
|       |   |-- matching result -> publish completed routes
|       |   `-- stale result -> discard; dispatch newest pending request
|       `-- no worker / worker failure -> synchronous ConnectionRouter fallback
|           `-- routing geometry stays transient; no document writes
`-- Persistence boundary: MappingPage + CanvasWorkspace
    |-- WorkspacePersistence connects workspace, storage records and view state
    |   `-- checkpoint/metadata changes request persistence for affected drafts
    |-- Acknowledged revision, view and generated-diagram mutations
    |   `-- sync affected draft -> await storage.flush() -> return result
    |       `-- creation/context receipts retained before flush allow retry
    |           without applying the mutation twice
    |-- Explicit Save
    |   `-- capture state -> sync + flush -> verify version -> publish checkpoint
    |       `-- acknowledgement updates captured saved baseline in [S]
    `-- Page hidden -> flush view state and storage
